set.body:
A raster/field grob whose colour mapping is chosen per column or per class index (e.g. diverging for task columns, muted grey ramp for nuisance), keeping scale semantics and legend support instead of consumers baking pixels.
Acceptance: one raster with two palettes renders identically in JavaFX, SVG and PNG; legends per class.

Consumer: PLS Neuro native model studio epic (see the PLS Neuro integration ticket that names this id). General capability; no application-specific branches.
PLS Neuro spec: docs/plans/2026-10-02-model-studio-spec.md and docs/design/model-studio/ (branch studio/model-authoring-hillclimb, f8d32f0).
set.title: [Intaglio] Raster colouriser with a palette per column or per class
